CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens, have graduated from high school, and be over the age of 18. 2. Nationality Requirements Comply with the provisions of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (MOE) Document No. 12 [2020] (Jiaowaihan) For applicants who are former residents of Chinese Mainland (the Chinese mainland), Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan and have immigrated to a foreign country, and now apply as international students: They must obtain a valid foreign passport or nationality certification document by April 30, 2022, provide proof of cancellation of Chinese nationality, and have a record of actually residing abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (Acumulative actual residence of 9 months or more in a foreign country within one year shall be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps.) For applicants who were born with foreign nationality (where either or both parents are Chinese citizens and have settled abroad): They must have a record of actually residing abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (A cumulative actual residence of 9 months or more in a foreign country within one year shall be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps.) Note: If an applicant is confirmed by Chinese public security authorities to hold Chinese nationality during the application, admission, or after enrollment, their application qualification, admission qualification, enrollment qualification will be cancelled, or they will be dismissed from school. 3. Applicants for English-taught programs must provide the certificate of TOEFL (80 or above), IELTS(6.0 or above) or Duolingo (100 or above) (with the exception for the applicants from the countries or regions where English is the official language or mother language). 4.
